info.name: InterviewAI Backend API
info.description:
API endpoints for the InterviewAI (Artizence) backend: mock interview links, LiveKit tokens, and post-interview transcript/analysis.

Quick start:
1. Set `base_url` (default http://localhost:8000, or https://interview-assistant-795o.onrender.com for prod).
2. Run `Create Mock Interview Link` — `session_id` and `interview_link` are auto-saved to collection variables.
3. Use `Join Mock Interview` to fetch LiveKit credentials, or `Complete Mock Interview` to test analysis without the UI.

All routes are served by FastAPI in backend/api.py.

request.description: Health check for the FastAPI server. Returns { message, status }.
Returns the catalog of available AI interviewers (alex, harry).

request.description:
Creates a mock interview session and returns `interview_link` for the candidate. Saves `session_id` and `interview_link` to collection variables for follow-up calls.

Body: interviewer_id, candidate_name, candidate_email are required; job_title, job_description, language are optional (language defaults to "en", use "hi" for Hindi).
Returns session metadata, `transcript`, and `analysis` (null until the interview is completed). Status: pending | in_progress | completed.

Returns LiveKit credentials (token, room_name, livekit_url) for the candidate join page and flips status to in_progress. Returns 400 if the interview is already completed; 404 if the session is unknown.
Saves transcript, runs Groq analysis, and marks the session completed. Use after create to test GET details without joining the UI.

request.description: Generates a LiveKit token without creating a persisted mock session. Returns token, room_name, livekit_url, interviewer.
Used by the LiveKit agent to fetch the customized system prompt for an interviewer.
Sends a transcript to Groq and returns strengths, weaknesses, feedback, and score (0-10). Requires GROQ_API_KEY on the server.
